verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão:

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ דִּגְל֤וֹ בְאֹתֹת֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִנֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְאֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ‘al- diḡ·lōw ḇə·’ō·ṯōṯ lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām ya·ḥă·nū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl min·ne·ḡeḏ sā·ḇîḇ lə·’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ ya·ḥă·nū
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it each man under his standard with the banners of his family . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel acampar-se-ão, cada um junto ao seu estandarte, com as insígnias das casas de seus pais; à alguma distância da tenda da revelação, se acamparão em roda.

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥō·nîm qê·ḏə·māh miz·rā·ḥāh de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê yə·hū·ḏāh naḥ·šō·wn ben- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: On the east side toward the sunrise the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard . . . The leader of the Judahites is Nahshon son of Amminadab
verses.literalPt: Os que se acamparem ao oriente serão os do estandarte do arraial de Judá, segundo as suas turmas; e o príncipe dos filhos de Judá será Naassom, filho de Aminadabe.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem ’ar·bā·‘āh wə·šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 74,600 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥō·nîm ‘ā·lāw maṭ·ṭêh yiś·śā·š·ḵār wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê yiś·śā·š·ḵār nə·ṯan·’êl ben- ṣū·‘ār
verses.literal: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it The leader of the Issacharites . . . is Nethanel son of Zuar
verses.literalPt: Os que se acamparem junto a ele serão da tribo de Issacar; e o príncipe dos filhos de Issacar será Natanael, filho de Zuar.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏāw ’ar·bā·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 54,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram cinquenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: maṭ·ṭêh zə·ḇū·lun wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê zə·ḇū·lun ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ben- ḥê·lōn
verses.literal: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun The leader of the Zebulunites . . . is Eliab son of Helon
verses.literalPt: A tribo de Zebulom; o príncipe dos filhos de Zebulom será Eliabe, filho de Helom.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏāw šiḇ·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 57,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram cinquenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm lə·ma·ḥă·nêh yə·hū·ḏāh mə·’aṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·mō·nîm ’e·lep̄ wə·šê·šeṯ- ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām ri·šō·nāh yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . they shall set out first
verses.literalPt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Judá eram cento e oitenta e seis mil e quatrocentos segundo as suas turmas. Estes marcharão primeiro.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh rə·’ū·ḇên tê·mā·nāh lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên ’ĕ·lî·ṣūr ben- šə·ḏê·’ūr
verses.literal: On the south side the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard The leader of the Reubenites . . . is Elizur son of Shedeur
verses.literalPt: Para a banda do sul, estará o estandarte do arraial de Rúben segundo as suas turmas; e o príncipe dos filhos de Rúben será Elizur, filho de Sedeur.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏāw šiš·šāh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 46,500 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: וְהַחוֹנִ֥ם עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽי־ שַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥō·w·nim ‘ā·lāw maṭ·ṭêh šim·‘ō·wn wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê šim·‘ō·wn šə·lu·mî·’êl ben- ṣū·rî- šad·dāy
verses.literal: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it The leader of the Simeonites . . . is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai
verses.literalPt: Os que se acamparem junto a ele serão da tribo de Simeão; e o príncipe dos filhos de Simeão será Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem tiš·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 59,300 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram cinquenta e nove mil e trezentos.

verses.original: וְמַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ רְעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·maṭ·ṭêh gāḏ wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê ḡāḏ ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- rə·‘ū·’êl
verses.literal: Next will be the tribe of Gad The leader of the Gadites . . . is Eliasaph son of Deuel
verses.literalPt: A tribo de Gade; o príncipe dos filhos de Gade será Eliasafe, filho de Reuel.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem ḥă·miš·šāh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: and his division numbers 45,650 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos e cinquenta.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְאֶחָ֨ד וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm lə·ma·ḥă·nêh rə·’ū·ḇên mə·’aṯ ’e·lep̄ wə·’e·ḥāḏ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām ū·šə·nî·yim yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . they shall set out second
verses.literalPt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Rúben eram cento e cinquenta e um mil e quatrocentos e cinquenta, segundo as suas turmas. Estes marcharão em segundo lugar.

verses.original: וְנָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־ יָד֖וֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sa‘ ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ ma·ḥă·nêh hal·wî·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ ham·ma·ḥă·nōṯ ka·’ă·šer ya·ḥă·nū kên yis·sā·‘ū ’îš ‘al- yā·ḏōw lə·ḏiḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: In the middle of the camps the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites They are to set out in the order they encamped . . . each in his own place under his standard
verses.literalPt: Então, partirá a tenda da revelação, com o arraial dos levitas no meio dos arraiais. Como se acamparem, assim marcharão, cada um no seu lugar, segundo os seus estandartes.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם יָ֑מָּה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.transliteration: de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām yām·māh wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ ben- ‘am·mî·hūḏ
verses.literal: On the west side the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard The leader of the Ephraimites . . . is Elishama son of Ammihud
verses.literalPt: Para a banda do ocidente, estará o estandarte do arraial de Efraim segundo as suas turmas; e o príncipe dos filhos de Efraim será Elisama, filho de Amiúde.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem ’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 40,500 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram quarenta mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: וְעָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāw maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê mə·naš·šeh gam·lî·’êl ben- pə·ḏā·h·ṣūr
verses.literal: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it The leader of the Manassites . . . is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur
verses.literalPt: Junto a ele, estará a tribo de Manassés; e o príncipe dos filhos de Manassés será Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: and his division numbers 32,200 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram trinta e dois mil e duzentos.

verses.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·maṭ·ṭêh bin·yā·min wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê ḇin·yā·min ’ă·ḇî·ḏān ben- giḏ·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin The leader of the Benjamites . . . is Abidan son of Gideoni
verses.literalPt: A tribo de Benjamim; o príncipe dos filhos de Benjamim será Abidã, filho de Gideoni.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem ḥă·miš·šāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 35,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁמֹֽנַת־ אֲלָפִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm lə·ma·ḥă·nêh ’ep̄·ra·yim mə·’aṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·mō·naṯ- ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mê·’āh lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām ū·šə·li·šîm yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100 . . . . . . . . . . . . they shall set out third
verses.literalPt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Efraim eram cento e oito mil e cem, segundo as suas turmas. Estes marcharão em terceiro lugar.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh ḏān ṣā·p̄ō·nāh lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê ḏān ’ă·ḥî·‘e·zer ben- ‘am·mî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: On the north side the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard The leader of the Danites . . . is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai
verses.literalPt: Para a banda do norte estará o estandarte do arraial de Dã segundo as suas turmas; e o príncipe dos filhos de Dã será Aiezer, filho de Amisadai.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem šə·na·yim wə·šiš·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 62,700 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥō·nîm ‘ā·lāw maṭ·ṭêh ’ā·šêr wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê ’ā·šêr paḡ·‘î·’êl ben- ‘ā·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it The leader of the Asherites . . . is Pagiel son of Ocran
verses.literalPt: Os que se acamparem junto a ele serão da tribo de Aser; e o príncipe dos filhos de Aser será Pagiel, filho de Ocrã.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 41,500 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî wə·nā·śî liḇ·nê nap̄·tā·lî ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali The leader of the Naphtalites . . . is Ahira son of Enan
verses.literalPt: A tribo de Naftali; e o príncipe dos filhos de Naftali será Aira, filho de Enã.

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem šə·lō·šāh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: and his division numbers 53,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A sua turma, e os que foram contados deles, eram cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַפְּקֻדִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm lə·ma·ḥă·nêh ḏān mə·’aṯ ’e·lep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ lā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh yis·‘ū lə·ḏiḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . they shall set out last under their standards
verses.literalPt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Dã eram cento e cinquenta e sete mil e seiscentos. Estes marcharão em último lugar, segundo os seus estandartes.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽמַּחֲנֹת֙ לְצִבְאֹתָ֔ם שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh pə·qū·ḏê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām kāl- pə·qū·ḏê ham·ma·ḥă·nōṯ lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: These are the Israelites . . . numbered according to their families . . . The total of those counted in the camps by their divisions was 603,550 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes são os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel segundo as casas de seus pais; todos os que foram contados dos arraiais segundo as suas turmas eram seiscentos e três mil e quinhentos e cinquenta.

verses.original: וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim lō hā·ṯə·pā·qə·ḏū bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites . . . as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Os levitas, porém, não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, assim como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן־ חָנ֤וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם֙ וְכֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖יו עַל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên- ḥā·nū lə·ḏiḡ·lê·hem wə·ḵên nā·sā·‘ū ’îš lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯāw ‘al- bêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did everything the LORD commanded Moses they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way each man with his clan and his family . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel; segundo tudo o que Jeová ordenou a Moisés, assim se acamparam segundo os seus estandartes e assim marcharam, cada um pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais.
